theme_strategy: Oxidized Copper on Graphite - Brutalist Technical Schematic

headings.usage: Headers, Main UI Labels, Primary Buttons, Tool Navigation

body_and_code.usage: Payload inputs, Recipe pipelines, Operations list, Code snippets, Data tables, IOC readouts

primary_accent.description: Oxidized Copper for primary actions, Run buttons, Active states, Hover highlights

secondary_accent.description: Phosphor Rust for Threat highlights, Warnings, Highlighted Recipe Steps

grids_and_layouts.workspace_layout: 3-column layout using strict Grid Borders pattern. Left col-span-3 (Operations), Center col-span-6 (Input/Recipe/Output pipeline), Right col-span-3 (Threat Analysis).
grids_and_layouts.borders: Sharp, 1px solid #2D3135 everywhere. Use border-r and border-b heavily to create separated panes like a blueprint schematic.
grids_and_layouts.radius: Minimal to none (rounded-none or max rounded-sm / 2px) to keep the brutalist-technical feel.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use tight packing for technical data (p-2, p-3) but wider gaps for panel separations.

component_rules.operations_panel: Dense vertical list format using JetBrains Mono. Use subtle left-border highlight (#4AA890) and right-aligned '+' icon on hover.
component_rules.recipe_pipeline: Sequential connected blocks. Use dashed or solid vertical lines to connect recipe steps. Include reorderable blocks with drag handle icons.
component_rules.payload_areas: Darker inset background (#0A0A0C). Use JetBrains Mono. Include character counter and clear actions in a thin toolbar above or below.
component_rules.threat_analysis_panel: Tabs on top (MITRE, YARA, IOCs, Chain, Graph). High density is key. Use square badge components for IOCs and MITRE tactics with tinted backgrounds.
component_rules.buttons: Sharp edges, flat background. Primary buttons use #4AA890 background with #101112 text for high contrast. Secondary buttons use transparent bg with #2D3135 border and hover state.
component_rules.badges: Square badges, no rounded corners. 1px border. Tinted background (e.g. bg-opacity-10) matching the border color.

motion_and_interactions.hover_reveals: Operations list items show an 'Add to Recipe' (+) icon smoothly on hover.
motion_and_interactions.pipeline_animation: When a new recipe is added or reordered, use layout animations (e.g., Framer Motion) for smooth sliding.
motion_and_interactions.staggered_load: Threat Analysis panel items (IOCs, MITRE badges) stagger-fade in when Auto Investigate completes.
motion_and_interactions.payload_banner: A small animated banner or pulse effect above output when payload type is auto-detected.
motion_and_interactions.chain_visualization: Graph tab should use visx or react-force-graph-2d for interactive, animated node connections.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire background to simulate a technical screen or RISO print texture.
visual_enhancers.depth: Avoid drop shadows. Use layered borders and inset backgrounds (darker shades like #0A0A0C) to denote depth and text areas.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in main UI. Use ONLY for floating contextual tooltips or dropdowns to add clarity without muddying the flat schematic look.

graph_visualization.reason: Best for visualizing Threat Analysis IOC chains, decode graphs, and network correlations without heavy overhead.

motion.reason: Essential for layout transitions in the recipe pipeline and staggered threat analysis results.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the #101112 and #18191B backgrounds meets WCAG AA (Text Primary #E5E7EB is ~14:1, Secondary #8B949E is ~5.5:1).
accessibility.focus_states: Use strict focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4AA890] focus:outline-none for all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.motion_preference: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion animations.

login_background.description: Abstract glitchy technical texture, best used with very low opacity (10-20%) blending into the background on the login/auth gate.

secondary_texture.description: Dark computer motherboard trace texture. Can be used in 'Threat Analysis' empty states or as a subtle banner background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React/Tailwind/Shadcn using Javascript (.js/.jsx files).
Do not use generic 'hacker green' (#00FF00) or 'cyber purple' (#800080). Strictly adhere to the Oxidized Copper (#4AA890) and Graphite (#101112) palette.
For the Main Workspace, build a 3-column layout using grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. Use 'border-collapse' style layout for the columns to make them feel like docked schematic panes.
Use Shadcn components but heavily customize them: remove rounded corners (rounded-none), remove default shadows, add 1px sharp borders using the defined border color.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for technical symbology (e.g., node graphs, brackets, database).
Build a Login gate first with a centered brutalist technical terminal vibe before revealing the main 3-column workspace.
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and inset backgrounds.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Always use modern, sharp-edged button styles relevant to the brutalist-technical aesthetic.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
